rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for luck, chance, or how successful an attempt turns out to be.

example.english: It was pure luck that I got it right this time, even though it was so difficult.
example.traditional: 今次真係運氣好，咁難都畀我撞中。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 wan6 hei3 hou2 gam2 naan4 dou1 bei2 ngo5 zong6 zung3

rows.note: Use this when the luck or fortune is specifically favourable or brings success.

example.english: Good luck with your interview this time—hope it goes smoothly.
example.traditional: 祝你今次好運，面試順順利利！
example.jyutping: zuk1 nei5 gam1 ci3 hou2 wan6 min6 si3 seon6 seon6 lei6 lei6

rows.note: Use this for an auspicious purpose or good-luck significance, as in doing something to攞個意頭.

example.english: We eat turnip cake at New Year just to have some luck on our side.
example.traditional: 新年食蘿蔔糕，攞個意頭啫。
example.jyutping: san1 nin4 sik6 lo4 baak6 gou1 lo2 go3 ji3 tau4 ze1
